svg.title: From equal characteristic classes to exact subgroup alignment
svg.desc: A central extension records the characteristic coefficients. A central change of core implementers aligns both discrete and real coefficients. Their quotient is fixed by the dual flow and lies in the original algebra. The resulting cochain aligns subgroup maps and cocycles. Under the analytic hypotheses of Section 7, intertwining followed by undoing the cochain gives strong cocycle conjugacy.

g.text: Equal classes → exact data in the original algebra
Q is the continuous core · M = Q fixed by ϑ · C = Z(Q) · N is a normal core-inner subgroup
kₙ = (Tₙ*, n); ι(z) = (z*, e). Both actions have the same centre action ρ.
χᴺ(α, vᵅ) = χᴺ(β, vᵝ) ⇒ choose zₙ ∈ U(C), Tᵝₙ ← zₙTᵝₙ
Then μᵅ = μᵝ, λᵅ = λᵝ, dᵅₜ(n) = dᵝₜ(n), where ϑₜ(Tₙ) = dₜ(n)Tₙ.
The equality includes every real time t; discrete coefficients alone do not give membership in M.
qₙ = Tᵅₙ(Tᵝₙ)*; ϑₜ(qₙ) = dₜ(n)qₙdₜ(n)* = qₙ ⇒ qₙ ∈ U(M)
β′ = q · β: β′ₙ = αₙ, vᵝ′(m,n) = vᵅ(m,n), Tᵝ′ₙ = Tᵅₙ (m,n ∈ N).
Set qg = 1 off N. All characteristic coefficients are preserved by the cochain transformation.
Under the analytic hypotheses of Section 7
TSI gives β′g = Ad(Vg) Θ αg Θ⁻¹. Set Wg = qg* Vg to recover β.
Equation (7.5) proves the full original cocycle identity in this order.
The arrows describe proved constructions; the final step retains all stated factor and amenability hypotheses.
